summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 with the SEC, dated 17 September 2026. The filing is a routine annual reporting disclosure by the foreign private issuer (NYSE American: GMTL; LSE: GMET; OTCQB: GMTLF), not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms, price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor engagement relating to any corporate action are stated. The release notes the Form 20-F is available on the Company's website and the SEC's EDGAR system.
